common_contract.decision_at: 15:30 Asia/Shanghai after the exact completed minute session and daily reconciliation
common_contract.entry: first legal raw open in the next three market sessions; expire if none
common_contract.buy_legal: hard-valid tradable row, finite positive open, not buy_blocked_open, no unresolved corporate action
common_contract.exit: first legal raw open on or after 1/3/5 market sessions from actual entry, searched for three sessions
common_contract.sell_legal: hard-valid tradable row, finite positive open, not sell_blocked_open, no unresolved corporate action
common_contract.t_plus_one: h1 exits no earlier than the market session after entry
common_contract.corporate_actions: fail closed if any corporate-action row or coordinate change occurs between signal and exit
common_contract.capacity: one percent of prior-20 mean daily amount; report P10 and median

track_a.historical_limit_semantics: repository-authoritative up_limit_price and limit_pct by security, board, ST state, and date; null/unresolved limits fail closed; no universal percentage
track_a.event_universe: broad hard-valid SH/SZ stock-days with exact CY-008 241-bar binding, current tradability, prior-20 mean amount >= CNY20m, and raw high touching the registered upper limit

minute_state.touch: completed bar high >= up_limit_price minus max(CNY0.001,abs(limit)*1e-6)
minute_state.accepted: completed bar close within the same tolerance of up_limit_price
minute_state.reopen: an accepted completed minute followed by a completed minute close below tolerance
minute_state.reseal: a later completed minute returns to accepted after reopen
minute_state.within_minute: high/close state only; transition order inside one bar is unresolved

taxonomy.EARLY_STABLE_ACCEPTANCE: closes accepted; first accepted bar end <=11:00; no completed-minute reopen after first acceptance
taxonomy.MID_STABLE_ACCEPTANCE: closes accepted; first accepted bar end >11:00 and <14:00; no completed-minute reopen
taxonomy.LATE_STABLE_ACCEPTANCE: closes accepted; first accepted bar end >=14:00; no completed-minute reopen
taxonomy.REOPEN_SUCCESSFUL_RESEAL: accepted, later reopens below limit, later reseals, and closes accepted
taxonomy.FAILED_ACCEPTANCE: touches the registered limit but closes below accepted tolerance, including touch-without-completed-acceptance

path_descriptors: accepted fraction of completed bars remaining after first touch
cumulative distance below limit after first touch

direct_contrasts.STABLE_VS_FAILED: three no-reopen stable classes versus FAILED_ACCEPTANCE
direct_contrasts.STABLE_VS_RESEAL: three no-reopen stable classes versus REOPEN_SUCCESSFUL_RESEAL

track_a.matching: same signal date and exact registered limit_pct; nearest prior-r20, log prior-20 amount, daily raw return, and turnover ratio after division by fixed scales [0.05,1.0,0.05,1.0], with exact-industry pool when nonempty and same-date fallback otherwise; outcomes excluded; deterministic symbol tie break

early_proxy.authorization: only if a close-known lifecycle class passes the information or standalone strategy gate
early_proxy.definition: by completed 14:00 bar, stock is accepted, first accepted no later than 11:00, and has no completed-minute reopen through 14:00

track_a.replay: at most one close-known continuation state, next legal open, equal-weight daily cohorts, fixed h3 open-to-open holding; only after standalone strategy gate

track_b.common_universe: hard-valid daily SH/SZ rows with 60 causal stock-session observations, registered limit coordinates, prior-20 mean amount >=CNY20m, and no current corporate action blocker

DORMANT_ACTIVE_CONSTRUCTIVE.event: prior-5 mean amount / prior-60 median amount <=0.65; current amount / prior-20 median in [2,5]; raw daily return >0; close location >=0.75; close limit-coordinate <0.90
DORMANT_ACTIVE_CONSTRUCTIVE.control: same liquidity transition and limit-coordinate exclusion, but event price-acceptance condition is false
DORMANT_ACTIVE_CONSTRUCTIVE.mechanism: new non-extreme participation whose price gain remains accepted

ACTIVITY_SHOCK_REJECTION.event: current amount / prior-20 median >=3 and (raw daily return <=0 or close location <=0.25), excluding limit touches
ACTIVITY_SHOCK_REJECTION.control: same activity shock with raw return >0 and close location >=0.50, excluding limit touches
ACTIVITY_SHOCK_REJECTION.mechanism: heavy activity without price acceptance as distribution/exhaustion

LIQUIDITY_RECOVERY_AFTER_WITHDRAWAL.event: prior session amount / its causal prior-20 median <=0.50; current amount / prior-20 median in [0.8,1.5]; abs(raw return)<=0.02; close location>=0.50
LIQUIDITY_RECOVERY_AFTER_WITHDRAWAL.control: same prior withdrawal but current amount / prior-20 median <=0.60
LIQUIDITY_RECOVERY_AFTER_WITHDRAWAL.mechanism: normalization and price stabilization after temporary activity withdrawal

track_b.matching: same date event-to-designated-control nearest on prior-r20, log prior-20 amount, and current activity ratio after division by fixed scales [0.05,1.0,1.0], using exact-industry pool when nonempty and same-date fallback otherwise; outcomes excluded; deterministic symbol tie break
track_b.replay: at most one hypothesis, equal-weight daily event cohort, next legal open, fixed h3 open-to-open holding; no rescue

cross_mechanism: descriptive event overlap only; no signal combination, conditioning, or rescue
prohibited: threshold, clock, horizon, taxonomy, sign, matching, Top-N, or exit search
Low-MAX, Industry Diffusion, RS veto, low-risk, revised momentum, MAX/MIN, confirmed breakdown, or leader/follower combination
OOS, independent-confirmation, validation, live, or production claims
